scope: Host Mesa instrumented fragment shader and native 84-record geometry replay; no device or production SVG/PDF parity claim.
details: At each target pixel the inserted diagnostic branch emits texture(sampler1, pointTexCoord).r and floor(pointTexCoord * texture size) in RGB with alpha 1; all earlier covering instances are overwritten by the last. Point values match the reported indices in the R8 input. Shader modification can alter compilation and interpolation; no claim about exact unmodified shader instructions.
interpretation: Projection candidate rounds rectangle endpoints through captured 1/96 binary32 NDC matrix and 192 viewport, then models local coordinates by linear division. The two sample points and full-frame errors improve, but this is not a validated exact triangle plane, device model, or SVG/PDF improvement.
limitations: One synthetic stroke and host transform; other geometry and contexts are untested.
Interpolation and shader arithmetic remain approximate; probe shader changes may affect compiler behavior.
Full-frame scalar error includes independent shader and compositing approximations.
